'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***Three people are killed in a [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] strike in [[Donetsk]]. Separately, two people are killed in Ukrainian strikes in [[Belgorod Oblast|Belgorod]] and [[Kursk Oblast|Kursk]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/one-killed-ukrainian-drone-strike-russias-belgorod-region-governor-2024-05-11/ (Reuters)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Eurovision Song Contest 2024]]
**[[Switzerland]]'s entry, "[[The Code (Nemo song)|The Code]]" by [[Nemo (rapper)|Nemo]], wins this year's Eurovision contest. [https://www.dw.com/en/eurovision-switzerland-wins-2024-song-contest/a-69054565 (DW)]
**[[Netherlands|Dutch]] musician [[Joost Klein]] is disqualified from the [[Eurovision]] final over reported verbal threats, which are under investigation by [[Sweden|Swedish]] authorities. This is the first time that a performer has been disqualified during the festival. [https://www.aftonbladet.se/nojesbladet/melodifestivalen/a/93vp7l/joost-klein-nederlanderna-eurovision-song-contest-diskas (''Aftonbladet'')]
**The [[Norway|Norwegian]] announcer for Eurovision, [[Alessandra Mele]], announces that she will withdraw from announcing votes while declaring support for [[State of Palestine|Palestine]] in the [[Israel–Hamas war|ongoing war]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/protesting-israels-inclusion-norway-singer-wont-announce-countrys-points-at-eurovision/ (''Times of Israel'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Afghanistan–Pakistan floods]]
**The death toll from the ongoing [[flood]]ing in northern [[Afghanistan]] increases to 300, with more than 1,000 houses destroyed. [https://apnews.com/article/afghanistan-flash-floods-rains-hundreds-dead-4a7aefabad9d3e38f0c5b5f20c3aa8da (AP)]
*[[2024 Rio Grande do Sul floods]]
**The death toll from the ongoing heavy flooding in southern [[Brazil]] increases to 136, with 125 still missing, and more than 300,000 people displaced. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/death-toll-floods-brazils-south-climbs-136-2024-05-11/ (Reuters)]
*At least 28 people are killed after heavy rains in the [[Agam Regency|Agam]] and [[Tanah Datar Regency|Tanah Datar]] districts in [[West Sumatra]], [[Indonesia]], which triggered a [[flash flood]] and cold [[lava]] flow from [[Mount Marapi]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/5/12/at-least-14-dead-several-missing-in-indonesia-flash-floods-cold-lava-flow (Al Jazeera)]
*Eleven people are killed and 53 others are injured when a bus crashes in [[West Java]], Indonesia. [https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-west-java-bus-accident-brakes-failure-0624b2eefe1e3fe42033a6865c77d99e (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023–2024 Georgian protests]]
**Fifty thousand people march in [[Tbilisi]], in protest of the proposed Law on Transparency of Foreign Influence. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/about-50000-march-against-foreign-agent-bill-tbilisi-georgia-2024-05-11/ (Reuters)]
